[SWS_V2xGn_00150] Development Error handling if V2xGn_TxConfirmation()
is indicated while V2XGn module is in uninitialized state
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_V2X_26011
⌈If development error detection is enabled: the function shall check that the service
V2xGn_Init was previously called.
If the check fails, the function shall raise the
development error V2XGN_E_UNINIT.⌋
